chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Every blessing will be questioned about by its owner, except for that which was in battle or hajj (pilgrimage)."

key_terms.حَجٍّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.غَزْوٍ: military campaign or battle in the way of Allah
key_terms.نَعِيمٍ: blessing, comfort, or worldly enjoyment granted to a person

ai.seo_question: Which blessings is a person not questioned about according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that people will be questioned about the blessings and comforts they enjoyed. It makes an exception for what was expended in jihad and hajj (pilgrimage), highlighting the special virtue of resources used in the way of Allah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2231 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Every blessing will be questioned about by its owner, except for that which was used in battle or Hajj."
